result.summary: Speeds up functional test execution by waking `wait_until_helper_internal` immediately on P2P message delivery or connection state changes using a `threading.Condition` instead of sleeping 50ms between polls. Also sets `noban_tx_relay = True` in three wallet tests to avoid transaction relay delays.
result.problem: Functional tests spend unnecessary time idle due to a fixed 50ms polling interval when waiting on P2P messages and events, and some wallet tests unnecessarily incur default transaction relay rate-limiting delays.
evidence: Author benchmarks report functional test suite wall time falling from 110.8s to 99.1s (-11% at -j=18) and accumulated CPU time falling from 1715s to 1411s (-17.5%).
Individual test runtimes decreased dramatically: `feature_maxuploadtarget` from 57.9s to 6.2s, `wallet_conflicts` from 49.2s to 7.0s, and `p2p_sendheaders` from 31.1s to 6.8s (author PR description).
result.scope_notes: Small test framework enhancement converting `p2p_lock` from `threading.Lock` to `threading.Condition`, alongside flag updates in three wallet test scripts.
result.changed_since_previous: No changes to the patch content or approach since the previous description.
result.card: Speeds up functional test execution by converting `p2p_lock` to a `threading.Condition` that immediately wakes `wait_until_helper_internal` upon P2P message delivery or connection changes instead of polling every 50ms, and sets `noban_tx_relay = True` across three wallet tests. This eliminates avoidable idle time in CI and local test execution. The author reports an 11% decrease in wall time (-j=18) and a 17.5% reduction in accumulated test runtime, with several individual test times dropping by 80% or more.

risk.why: Touches only functional test framework synchronization and test configurations; any regression would result in test flakiness or deadlocks without affecting release binaries.
